prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant us, O merciful God, protection in our weakness.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus de misericórdia, socorrei a nossa fraqueza.

meta.face: Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md: a young woman of about eighteen with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre, under the long white veil of the apparition, about sixteen as Bernadette saw her, smiling faintly. Bernadette, clearly different and earthier: a girl of fourteen, small and slight, with a SOFT OVAL face a little broad across the cheekbones — a smooth, rather high forehead, strong, straight, dark brows nearly level, large dark-brown eyes set wide apart, a straight nose with a slightly broad, rounded tip, full lips in a small closed mouth, a softly rounded chin; olive, sun-browned skin; very dark brown hair, centre-parted and drawn back under the capulet; her gaze lifted, rapt and simple.
meta.basis: The Lady's dress follows Bernadette's own account (white dress, blue sash, white veil, a yellow rose on each foot, a rosary of white beads with a chain of the same colour as the roses); Bernadette's face comes from the Billard-Perrin and Dufour photographs of 1861–63, softened to fourteen.
